readme: Values the extension computes at runtime, precomputed. Emit them verbatim. Keys are referenced by chapter from handoff/native-render-migration/.

itemAtlases.formula: atlasW = cols*cell; atlasH = rows*cell; background-size = `${atlasW/w*100}% ${atlasH/h*100}%`; background-position = `${(x/(atlasW-w)*100).toFixed(6)}% ${(y/(atlasH-h)*100).toFixed(6)}%` (0 when atlasW<=w / atlasH<=h); background-repeat: no-repeat. Resolution order: AtlasService.resolve().

FORGE.liveShadow: inset 0 0 12px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fs-skill-accent, #D8791F) 55%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 216, 150, .18), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fs-skill-accent, #D8791F) 16%, transparent)
